name: stable-diffusion.cpp
description: Diffusion model(SD,Flux,Wan,Qwen Image,Z-Image,...) inference in pure C/C++
one_liner: Software that generates AI images directly on your own computer's chip, with no internet connection, cloud bill, or Python installation required.
buyer: An indie app developer who wants to add AI image generation to a desktop or offline app without paying per-image API fees or requiring users to be online.
business_use_cases: An indie developer builds a one-time-purchase desktop app for generating local product mockups or avatars, with zero per-image API cost since generation runs on-device.
A game studio embeds local offline texture/asset generation into a level editor so artists can iterate without waiting on or paying for cloud API calls.
A privacy-focused creative tool for a regulated industry (e.g. medical illustration drafts) uses on-device generation so no image data ever leaves the user's machine.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a one-time-purchase desktop app with unlimited local image generation instead of a per-image subscription.
License an embeddable offline generation module to other app developers who want to avoid cloud API costs.

steal_this: Wrap it in a minimal desktop UI ('type a prompt, get a local image, no account needed') and sell it as a $15 one-time app to people who are tired of paying per-generation on cloud image tools.
